title: Bus travel gets costlier in Karnataka; fares hiked by 23% to 35%
description: According to the revised fare structure, BMTC fares have increased by ₹4 to ₹12, depending on the distance travelled. For KSRTC, NWKRTC and KKRTC services, the increase ranges from ₹9 to ₹18, depending on the stages of travel and the type of service.
